title: Gazans search for bodies buried under rubble since 2023 strike
description:
Members of Gaza's civil defence search through the rubble of a building hit in November 2023 in the central Gaza Strip area of Nuseirat, looking for the remains of victims still buried beneath the debris. "We need more equipment, and bigger equipment, to recover all the remains of the victims buried beneath the rubble. If we continue using this method, it could take many years," says Mahmoud Basal, spokesperson for Gaza's civil defence.
